blocks.text: Turn down the world's noise with the long-lasting noise cancellation performance. Featuring Dual Noise Sensor technology and an Integrated Processor V1, the WH-CH720N allows you to fully immerse yourself in music without any distractions. Ergonomically designed to be lightweight, comfortable, and with up to 35 hours of battery life, you’ll almost forget you’re wearing it.

items.label: SONY’S LIGHTEST WIRELESS NOISE CANCELING HEADBAND EVER
items.value: Weighing just 192g, our lightest overhead wireless headphones with Noise Canceling yet, for incredible comfort without compromising on technology.

items.label: DUAL NOISE SENSOR TECHNOLOGY
items.value: Take noise canceling to the next level with Sony’s Integrated Processor V1, so you can fully immerse yourself in the music.

items.label: SMART FEATURES
items.value: Adjustable Ambient Sound mode and Adaptive Sound control features tailors sound to suit the environment around you.

items.label: LONG BATTERY LIFE
items.value: Up to 35-hour battery life with quick charging (3 min charge for up to 1 hour of playback).(USB Type-C Cable included

items.label: SUPERB SOUND
items.value: Enjoy natural vocals, crystal clear sound and balanced tuning thanks to the Integrated Processor V1 and Digital Sound Enhancement Engine (DSEE), producing a high-quality sound exactly as the artists intended.

items.label: CRYSTAL CLEAR HANDS FREE CALLING
items.value: Precise Voice Pickup Technology uses beamforming microphones pick up voices clearly and accurately.

items.label: MULTIPOINT CONNECTION
items.value: Quickly switch between two devices at once.

items.label: GIVE YOUR MUSIC A BOOST
items.value: Boost the quality of compressed music files and enjoy streaming music with high quality sound through DSEE.

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: Headphone cable (approx. 1.2 m (47.25 in.), Headphones, USB Type-C cable (USB-A to USB-C) (approx. 20 cm (7.88 in.))

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Adaptive Sound control, Adjustable Ambient Sound mode, Dual Noise Sensor technology, Long battery with quick charging, Microphone Included, Multipoint connection
